title: Dedup State Manager
description: Manages rule dedup state: which rules have fired in which sessions. Supports per-session and per-rule repeat logic.

hasFired.description: Check if a rule has already fired in this session (respects repeat: false/N cooldown).

markFired.description: Record that a rule fired in a session.

clearSession.description: Remove all dedup state for a session (on session end).

dump.description: Export full dedup state as JSON for backup/inspection.

restore.description: Restore dedup state from backup JSON.

x-docs.intent: Singleton state object. Persisted to run/hook-state.json. Prevents rule firing repeatedly within a session, saving tokens and avoiding duplicate processing.
